$comment: VAPP-110 Exponential apps ×4 (web routes/t/$teamSlug/apps/*, desktop crates/ui apps screens, iOS Apps/*, Android ui/apps/*). An APP = a team-scoped declarative package (the Exponential UI SDK's format: manifest + A2UI templates + bindings + a function allowlist, data never code) rendered by the Exponential UI renderers through the client's app host (`exp:` bindings over the synced store, `harness.*` functions behind the consent card, the URL policy). ONE look ×4. THE LIST (`apps` view, nav entry `copy.nav` between Threads and Devices, the IDE rail alike; the phones' third tab): a Section band `copy.title` with `copy.newApp` as its trailing action pill, then ListRows = BoardGlyph (icon + colour, the board set) + name (medium) + the version pill `copy.version` (`v{n}`; `copy.noVersion` muted while head_version = 0) + a trailing `…` menu (`copy.menu.*`: Rename → the New app form prefilled, Delete → the confirm prompt `copy.deleteTitle`/`copy.deleteBody`, members may delete only their own apps, owners every app). Exponential ships NO built-in apps (2026-10-24): the list is the team's synced apps only. Rows sort by name (case-insensitive). Empty (a team with no apps): the list-size EmptyState `copy.empty` under the band. NEW APP (`copy.newApp`): a dialog/sheet with the board form's identity row (icon + colour + name) and `copy.descriptionPlaceholder` (multi-line, optional); Create = tRPC `apps.create` (slug derived from the name: `slugify`, de-duplicated with `-2`, `-3`), then the editor opens. THE EDITOR (`app` view, route `/t/$teamSlug/apps/$appSlug`): header = BoardGlyph + name + the version pill + `copy.versions` button (a count badge) + the `…` menu; BODY on web ≥ md and desktop = two panes `panes.chat` : `panes.preview` (fr), a hairline between; on phones (and web < md) a SegmentedControl `copy.tabs.*` under the header (Chat | Preview | Versions) and ONE pane. CHAT = the member's EDITOR SESSION with the app (a root with `sessions.app_id` + `user_id` = me): the same channel rows as a team agent's conversation (ChannelMessageRow: avatar / the app glyph, name, time, body; cards answer in place) and THE composer (`copy.composerPlaceholder`); no session yet = the same pane, empty, whose composer's first send is `sessions.send({appId, text, deviceId})` (the device = the caller's default device, `launch-device`; none online = the composer disabled with `copy.noDevice`). `copy.chatEmpty` sits in the empty chat. LIFETIME: entering the editor starts nothing; leaving it (route change, tab close) ENDS the member's live editor session (`sessions.end` on the root: the tree); the next send revives the same root (FEED-134: the row goes idle again with its context, so the chat is that root's messages). PREVIEW = the app host rendering the HEAD package's first template (`applyTemplate`, surface id = the slug) in a frame `preview.radius` px / `preview.padding` px with the theme's background; the apps shape carries the head package, so every MCP `apps upsert` repaints it live. No version yet: the page-size EmptyState `copy.previewEmpty` in the frame. The HostBanner (offline / catalog update) sits above the surface; the consent card is the client's. VERSIONS (`copy.versions`: a Drawer on web ≥ md and desktop, the third tab on phones): rows newest first = `copy.version` (`v{n}`) medium + `note` (muted, `copy.noNote` when empty) + the relative time + who (a person's avatar + name, or `copy.byAgent`); the head row carries `copy.head`. Tapping a row PREVIEWS that version (the preview pane re-renders it; a banner `copy.viewing` with `copy.restore` above the surface; the head row clears it); Restore = tRPC `apps.restore` → a NEW head version `copy.restoredNote` (`Restored v{n}`), toast `copy.restored`. CAPS: contract `apps` (slug, name, description, note, package bytes, components per template). RECORDS (VAPP-122, fixtures/app-records.json): an app keeps its own data as records (`records: {<kind>: {schema}}` in the manifest; `exp:records?kind=…` reads them live, `harness.records.upsert/delete` write them, no consent card); the app's SETTINGS page (web + desktop) shows the count as one muted line under the description: `recordsCountLabel` (`copy.records*`: `1,240 records`, with the plan quota `1,240 of 25,000 records`, `No records`); the quota (plan-limits `appRecords`, cloud only) refuses a write with the plan-limit error, shown as a toast. TOOLS (VAPP-120, fixtures/app-actions.json): every MCP operation is a typed host function `exponential.<noun>.<op>`; the app's SETTINGS page (web + desktop) shows a `copy.tools` group under the records line: `copy.tools.title` with `copy.tools.hint`, one ListRow per function the head package declares (the display title + the function name muted + a Switch = the grant, a team OWNER only, disabled for everyone else; a destructive action shows `copy.tools.always` in place of the switch: it can never be granted), `copy.tools.none` when it declares none; `apps.granted_tools` syncs on the apps shape; a switch writes the whole list WITH the head version on screen (`apps.update {grantedTools, headVersion}`, VAPP-156): a head published meanwhile refuses with CONFLICT (the failed-action toast), the row resyncs and the owner grants again; a granted call runs without the consent card, an ungranted or destructive one asks with the operation's words. FEEDBACK: a failed create/delete/restore = toast (feedback-states.json); an invalid name inline. Model = pure `apps.ts` (TS reference): every mirror replays `slugifyCases`, `versionLabelCases` and `sortAppsCases`. DESKTOP NAV (web ≥ md + the IDE rail): no plain Apps nav row; an APPS sidebar GROUP drawn exactly like Agents and Boards, between them: the label `copy.title`, a `+` group action opening the New app form, one compact row per app (its glyph in its colour + name → the editor), the hover gear (the creator or an owner) → Settings → Apps → the app. The compact rail shows the app icons after the agent icons. SETTINGS mirrors Agents: an `Apps` settings group listing the apps + `copy.newApp`, the index page = the Apps band whose rows open the app's SETTINGS page (identity row: icon + colour + name with the name a deferred write, the description card saved on blur, `copy.openEditor`, the version pill, Delete for the creator or an owner), `/settings/apps/new` = the same page in create mode (Create opens the editor). PHONES: the Apps LIST is the APPS TAB (chats.json `shell.tabs`, #EXP-1379), a top-level page under the shared page header (`copy.title`, search + inbox circles); its `copy.newApp` pill stays on the Section band. VAPP-129 (web ≥ md and the IDE; phones keep Chat | Preview | Versions): the editor has two LAYOUTS, `layout.default` first, the choice kept per device (`layout.storageKey`). FLOATING = the preview takes the whole body and the chat lives in THE Dock (dock.json, N-12) floating over the preview's bottom edge: ONE DockCard of kind `chat` (tint muted, `dockCard.icon`, label `copy.tabs.chat`, title = the newest message's first plain line, else `copy.chatEmpty`; caption = `copy.working` while the editor session is busy, else null; meta null; expandable, so no action word: THE Dock card shows the open chevron OR an action, never both) over THE composer (the editor's: the session composer once the editor session exists, else the first-send composer). A click on the card opens the Dock sheet: the header = the card's icon, label and caption, its meta slot = the `copy.dockToSide` ghost button; the ONE scrolling body = the chat's rows (the same channel rows), no footer; the composer stays in the band under it. The sheet's `copy.dockToSide` button (`dockCard.dockIcon`) switches to DOCKED = today's two panes (chat `panes.chat` : preview `panes.preview`), the chat pane led by a header strip (`panes.headerHeight` px, a hairline under it): `copy.tabs.chat` muted at the start, the `copy.float` ghost icon button (`dockCard.floatIcon`) at the end, which switches back.

mediaPolicy.$comment: VAPP-157 (the 2026-10-28 ruling) THE APP HOSTS' MEDIA RULE ×4: an Exponential app's Image / Avatar / Video / Audio src and markdown image loads ONLY when it is (a) a `data:` url whose mime is image/*, audio/* or video/* except image/svg+xml (scheme and mime case-insensitive), or (b) the instance's own attachment, `/api/attachments/<uuid>` relative or absolute on the instance's exact origin (scheme, host case-insensitive, port), the RAW path exactly that (no dot segments, no percent-encoding, no trailing segment), no query, no fragment, no credentials, no surrounding whitespace. Anything else loads nothing (the SDK's existing denied-src rendering: no request, no new UI), so bound team data can never ride a url to another host. The web, desktop, iOS and Android app hosts narrow the SDK's media policy with it (`appMediaAllowed(src, origin)`; a host narrows, never widens); the SDK's own generic default and the link policy are unchanged. `cases` replay ×4 against `origin`.

cases.$why: a relative attachment url resolves against the instance
the instance's own absolute attachment url
a suffix is a different host
dot segments: the raw path must already be the attachment path
an encoded slash in the prefix
the id must be a uuid
data scheme and mime compare case-insensitively
svg is denied: not every image path sandboxes it
svg is denied in any case
only image, audio and video data
a data url needs a media mime
